title: CorpusManifest
description: Language-neutral schema for an OpenECS v1.x corpus manifest. The on-disk form is TOML (see SPEC/OpenECS-v1.1.md §8). Mirrors open_eeg_codec_standard::corpus::CorpusManifest. v1.1 adds `content_identity` and the exact-rate pair `fs_num`/`fs_den`; `abir_identity` is the v1.0 block, read but no longer written or verified.

spec_version.description: OpenECS spec version the manifest targets. Defaults to the grader's own ("1.1").

content_identity.description: Codec-agnostic content identity of the decoded corpus (OpenECS v1.1 §8.2). Optional on legacy reads; mandatory on new writes; verified before a grade is accepted.

version.description: Identity construction version. v1.1 graders implement 1.

content_identity.$comment: Structurally optional so v1.0 manifests validate; a v1.1 writer MUST emit it (SPEC/OpenECS-v1.1.md §8.2) and the reference grader verifies it when present.

abir_identity.description: LEGACY (OpenECS v1.0): the ABIR semantic identity 1.0 writers emitted. A v1.1 grader reads it, warns, and neither verifies nor writes it. Retained so 1.0 manifests still validate.

file.description: The pinned files. In TOML this is an array of [[file]] tables.

path.description: Path to the EDF file, relative to the manifest's directory.

sha256.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the file bytes. Verified before grading.

fs_num.description: Numerator of the exact sample rate fs_num/fs_den (v1.1 §8.2.3), in lowest terms, agreeing with `fs`. New writers emit both; when absent the grader derives the pair as the exact binary rational of `fs`.

fs_den.description: Denominator of the exact sample rate; see fs_num. Declared together with it or not at all.

n_chan.description: Expected channel count. Encoded as u32le in the content identity (§8.2), hence the maximum.
